Primary Table 4 labels ATCC 14028 as S. typhi; linked DBAASP rows name Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium ATCC 14028. Values are mapped but the nomenclature conflict is preserved.
The local supplementary ZIP contains a 69-page PDF of UPLC/MS/NMR/UV-Vis characterization; pdftotext search found no MIC/IC50/HC50/selectivity table beyond characterization headings.
AFM supports membrane-damage morphology, but no molecular target, permeabilization kinetics, or LPS-binding assay is reported locally.
